definitions.gloss: construction; execution of building or civil engineering work
definitions.explanation: The process of carrying out construction or civil engineering projects according to design plans.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{来月|らいげつ}{施工|せこう}{開始|かいし}{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: Construction of this building is scheduled to begin next month.

examples.japanese: {施工|せこう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}と{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせをする。
examples.english: I'll have a meeting with the construction contractor.

examples.japanese: {施工|せこう}{管理|かんり}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。

notes:
PRONUNCIATION NOTE:
・{施工|せこう} (せこう) - standard pronunciation
・{施工|しこう} - also acceptable, but less common in construction industry

DO NOT CONFUSE WITH:
・{施行|しこう} (implementation/enforcement of law) - same kanji reading pattern but different meaning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{施工|せこう}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (construction contractor)
・{施工|せこう}{管理|かんり} (construction management)
・{施工|せこう}{図|ず} (construction drawing)
・{施工|せこう}{会社|がいしゃ} (construction company)
・{施工|せこう}{期間|きかん} (construction period)

CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY TERMS:
・{設計|せっけい} (design)
・{施工|せこう} (construction)
・{検査|けんさ} (inspection)
・{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し (handover)
